Name: Amgen Inc
Description: Amgen Inc. is a leading multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California, specializing in the development, manufacture, and commercialization of innovative therapies based on recombinant DNA technology. With a strong commitment to molecular biology and biochemistry, Amgen focuses on oncology, nephrology, and inflammation, delivering biologic products that significantly improve patient outcomes. As a pioneer in biotechnology with a robust pipeline and a strong market presence, Amgen continues to drive advancements in medicine while actively addressing unmet medical needs globally.
